requirements.summary: IA-02 must record explicit local operator approval before any live metadata request.
The future live path must check the IA kill switch before every request and fail closed.
A descriptive Eureka User-Agent and operator-configured contact are required before live.
Small first-probe row caps are mandatory; no deep paging.
Every future request must use an explicit timeout.
Retry budget must be finite and conservative.
Cache is required before repeat requests.
IA-02 may only approve one-shot small local probes.
Public user queries must not fan out to IA.
No file or media downloads are permitted.
